title: The Shattered Halls
body: The Shattered Halls lie at the heart of Hellfire Citadel behind a door the fel orcs keep locked, and they belong to the Shattered Hand clan and its chieftain, Kargath Bladefist. The halls are given over to war: gladiators spar under the eyes of centurions, houndmasters keep rabid warhounds, archers drill to loose burning arrows on command, and everywhere the same cries ring out: the blood is our power, ours is the true Horde, for Kargath and for victory.

parts.body: Its key was cast from a mold taken in Shadowmoon Valley, marked with the Shattered Hand's symbol, and tempered in the fel fire at the heart of a fallen fel reaver.
sources: zones/shattered_halls.txt (map 540: 3714, and 3535 Hellfire Citadel, the citadel-wide quest sort, not reachable)

parts.body: Kargath keeps prisoners here to be executed, soldiers of Honor Hold or Thrallmar, and among them a captain of the Alliance or of the Horde.

title: Grand Warlock Nethekurse
body: Grand Warlock Nethekurse holds a chamber in the Shattered Halls where he amuses himself by tormenting his own kind, trying his spells on the fel orc converts who wail that their skin is on fire. Two strange braziers burn beside him, and the fel embers in them lend his magic its power.

parts.body: One of his embers went to a magus at Honor Hold, who means to study it in secret, for there are those who would forbid such research.

title: Warchief Kargath Bladefist
body: Kargath Bladefist, chieftain of the Shattered Hand, wears a blade where one hand should be. Long ago, while Ner'zhul worked to open the rifts that tore Draenor apart, Kargath was left to hold Hellfire Citadel against the Alliance. The fortress fell, and he escaped swearing he would take it back. He has, and he calls himself warchief of the true Horde. Thrall has ordered him defeated at all costs.

parts.body: Nazgrel took his death without triumph. In his prime, he said, Kargath was a hero and an example to his people, and the orcs should remember the one he once was, and the lessons of his fall.
sources: quests 9492 (Danath, Alliance) and 9495 (Nazgrel, Horde) descriptions and reward text (self-styled Warchief; Thrall's command; won't rest until Thrallmar is destroyed; Warchief Kargath's Fist)

parts.body: Danath Trollbane took Kargath's fist as proof of a major blow, and meant the Sons of Lothar to do far more now than defend Honor Hold.
